name: niyusha-web-kit
description: Kit website modern khas Niyusha — original MIT, zero-dep, premium & rapi
fonts: System + Geist (fallback Inter) - no external CDN, self-contained via system stack

signature_components.nav: sticky glass blur, brand mark conic-gradient, CTA pill
signature_components.hero: headline fluid clamp + 1 kata gradien, chip dot status, 2 CTA, visual bento/glass
signature_components.features: bento asimetris (span), kartu glass, ikon garis 24px, hover lift

rules: Standar modern WAJIB: struktur lengkap nav→hero→fitur→stats→cara→CTA→footer; tipografi fluid clamp; copy domain NYATA tanpa label meta/dev maupun placeholder; ikon garis 24px DARI DAFTAR (jangan karang path); wajib visual; responsif; dark/light; a11y AA; konsisten antar-halaman (nav/footer/brand/warna). Semua pakai tokens.json (CSS var), zero-dep. Aksen mono // maks 1-2x. Credit footer hanya bila cfg().credit.
